meta.description: Solubility of LiOH (solid phase LiOH.H2O) in pure water
meta.conversion: x_sat = s/(100+s) [kg LiOH/kg solution]; per-kg-water s/100. From g hydrate/100 g water H: s = 100*0.5708*H/(100+0.4292*H)
meta.interpolation: linear in T between selected points; flagged as extrapolation above 115.6 C
meta.decision_100C: 17.5 g/100 g water (x_sat = 0.149) selected. ChemicalBook states it per 100 g water and Battelle BMI-1329 (from Seidell) gives 17.7 g/100 g at 240 F with a solubility maximum near 210 F, consistent with ~17.5 at 100 C. Parchem's 15.0 is treated as an outlier. Wikipedia's per-100 mL label is probably a mislabel. Muse's critique value is therefore accepted; Claude's earlier dispute was wrong.
meta.shape_warning: Between 25 C and 100 C only end points are sourced; the linear interpolation is an estimate (real curve is probably flatter at low T and steeper near 100 C). Replace with Monnin & Dubois (2005) or CRC table when obtained.

observations.basis: g/100 g water (stated per 100 mL on Wikipedia)

observations.note: Conflicts slightly with the 25 C measurement; not used
